evidence: In-line transparent dustbin with gold cyclone assembly and purple rear filter housing.
Body layout and absence of a top push-button power switch match the trigger-operated V15 Detect.

candidate_checks.evidence: In-line clear bin, gold multi-cone cyclone assembly, and purple filter housing match the V15 Detect.
Lacks the top red push-button power switch on the cyclone housing characteristic of the V12 Detect Slim.
Features an in-line bin rather than the perpendicular bin layout of the V8 family.
Stick vacuum layout contradicts the canister and hose construction of the Big Ball.
Features traditional gold cyclone cones rather than the CleanCompaktor mechanism of the V16.
Dry cordless stick vacuum architecture contradicts the dual-tank wet cleaner design of the WashG1.
